neighbours.label: the suffix piece of a word for a small repeated sound or motion (rust|ling, crack|ling, ratt|ling, oscill|ation)
fire: Outside the tent we heard dry leaves rustling in the dark.
By the evening the logs were crackling in the stove.
All night the loose shutters kept rattling in the wind.
Far away we could hear thunder rumbling over the hills.
Under the door the candle was flickering in the draft.
In the lab the beam showed a slow oscillation after each push.
From the pipes came a gurgling noise every few minutes.
On the cliff the wind was whistling through the cracks.
quiet: Outside the tent we heard dry leaves fall in the dark.
By the evening the logs were burning in the stove.
All night the loose shutters stayed shut against the wind.
Far away we could see clouds gathering over the hills.
Under the door the candle was burning in the draft.
In the lab the beam showed a small bend after each push.
From the pipes came a bad smell every few minutes.
On the cliff the wind was blowing through the cracks.

notes: Probe: rust|ling 0.44, oscill|ation 0.14, fluct|uation 0.07, artic|ulation 0.04. Non-motion -ation words (education, population, nation) gave ~0. The pole is weak outside rustling, so the median may fail. Every fire word is split into pieces (tokenizer checked).
